title: Missing cells survive unpivot
brief: Expand a matrix without silently dropping missing cells.
instructions: Expand every monthly matrix row to exactly three reason rows, including NULL cells. Preserve genuine zero and sort month then reason.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes mon,damaged,wrong_item,unwanted from monthly_matrix without solving missing cells survive unpivot.

hints.text: UNPIVOT normally excludes NULL cells; request their inclusion.
Use the standard UNPIVOT INCLUDE NULLS clause with the three named measures.
January wrong_item and February damaged are NULL, not zero and not absent rows.

dataClaims.sql: SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE mon = DATE '2024-01-01' AND wrong_item IS NULL))::VARCHAR || '/' || (count(*) FILTER (WHERE mon = DATE '2024-02-01' AND damaged IS NULL))::VARCHAR FROM monthly_matrix
dataClaims.claim: hints[2]: January wrong_item and February damaged are NULL
